name: refract
description: git log for Wikipedia: typed events for changed sentences, citations, and structure on any page.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Analyze the full edit history of a Wikipedia page. Returns structured events including claim changes, citation changes, section moves, template changes, reverts, and semantic enrichment fields.

tools.name: claim
tools.description: Track a specific text claim across Wikipedia revisions. Returns claim lineage: when it first appeared, how it changed, when it was removed or reintroduced.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export page analysis as structured JSON, with revision, section, and timestamp provenance on each event.

tools.name: cron
tools.description: One-shot re-observation: reads a pages file, analyzes each page, and reports its event count.

input.pagesFile: string (path to file with page titles, one per line)

tools.name: classify
tools.description: Model-assisted classification of an inference boundary. Replaces default heuristic with an LLM-based decision for one boundary.

tools.name: get_statement_history
tools.description: Track a statement's trajectory across a page's revisions by normalized text or sentence word overlap (a partial match does not establish the same meaning): each transition (first seen, wording changed, removed, reintroduced) between the fetched revisions it lies between, with revert evidence and how long the result held, plus an overall status and a short change summary.

input.from: number optional (read forward from this revision ID)
input.to: number optional (read back from this revision ID)

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Return the revision of a page that was live at a date, with its revision ID, timestamp, section headings, and text.

tools.name: review
tools.description: Observe changes to pages since their last acknowledged review and return the saved review report. Never acknowledges; it returns the CLI command a person runs after inspecting the report.

input.stateDir: string (absolute path; all state and reports are written here)
